name: Sakurai Tsubasa
source:
A rookie policewoman who works in the traffic division of the Metropolitan Police.
She was suddenly transferred to the Emergency Mission Investigations Unit by the chief.
She has a special skill to never forget the face and name of anybody she meets even just once.
